title: A2-23 · Listening: the news and the first meeting with the Egyptian

blocks.text: A2-23 · Listen: the news and the first meeting with
the Egyptian
Lesson overview

This unit is dedicated to listening. In the first week you learn to listen to a simplified news: what to look for at first listening, how to take note of numbers and own names, what formulas come back every day ( ⁧وَفْقًا لِـ⁩ , ⁧أَعْلَنَ أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَشَارَ إِلَى أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧مِنَ المُتَوَقَّعِ أَنْ⁩ ). In the second week you meet for the first time the Egyptian Arab, the spoken variety that you heard on the street in Cairo. The goal is only to recognize it: to understand that a phrase is Egyptian, to identify the main traits (sounds, negation, future, present with ⁧بـ⁩ ) and bring it back to fuṣḥā. In this unit nothing is produced in dialect: you always speak and write in standard Arabic. Two weeks.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-23), EGY deck (recognition only), voice synthesis scripts (texts in fuṣḥā), an Egyptian player for D and E scripts, session with the tutor

Audio. This book does not contain any recordings. Scripts in fuṣḥā (A, B, C) are heard with vocal synthesis or read by the tutor. Egyptian scripts (D, E) are to be read by an Egyptian speaker (tutor, colleague, linguistic exchange): the vocal synthesis does not reliably pronounce the dialect. Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. use a strategy in three listenings (subject → data → details);
2. recognize the fixed formulas of the news and report a news with ⁧قَالَ إِنَّ⁩ , ⁧أَعْلَنَ أَنَّ⁩ , ⁧وَفْقًا لِـ⁩ ;
3. record numbers, dates, percentages and foreign names heard;
4. summarize a slow news in English;
5. recognizing the Egyptian: the sounds ( ⁧ج⁩ , ⁧ق⁩ , ⁧ث⁩ , ⁧ذ⁩ The present with ⁧بـ⁩ , the future ḥa- / ha-, denial But...-š and miš, the most frequent words;
6. Reaching a simple Egyptian phrase to fuṣḥā.

2. Listening Strategies

Three practical rules. 1. Do not stop the audio from every unknown word: listen until the end of the news. 2. News almost always has the same order: who → what → where → when → details → statement. 3. The verb at the beginning of the sentence ( ⁧أَعْلَنَ⁩ , ⁧وَقَعَ⁩ , ⁧اِرْتَفَعَ⁩ ) tells you the kind of news right away.
3. The Language of the News

rows: And in sports... · And now the weather...

blocks.text: The verb-subject order. In the news the verb comes almost always first, and remains singular even with a plural subject: ⁧أُصِيبَ ثَلَاثَةُ أَشْخَاصٍ⁩ , ⁧اِجْتَمَعَ الوُزَرَاءُ⁩ . He only agrees in the genre: ⁧أَعْلَنَتِ الشُّرْطَةُ⁩ . ⁧أَنَّ⁩ after the verbs say. With ⁧قَالَ⁩ is used ⁧إِنَّ⁩ ( A2-19); with all other verbs ( ⁧أَعْلَنَ⁩ , ⁧أَشَارَ إِلَى⁩ , ⁧أَضَافَ⁩ , ⁧أَكَّدَ⁩ ) used ⁧أَنَّ⁩ .
4. Own numbers and names

The numbers are heard on the contrary. From 21 a 99 Arabic first says units: ⁧خَمْسَةٌ وَعِشْرُونَ⁩ = 25 ('five and twenty'). When you listen, write the first digit to the right, or wait until the end of the number before writing. Years read in full (A2-12): ⁧عَامَ أَلْفَيْنِ وَسِتَّةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ⁩ In 2026», ⁧عَامَ أَلْفٍ وَتِسْعِمِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٍ وَثَمَانِينَ⁩ In 1988». Percentages end with ⁧بِالمِئَةِ⁩ ( A2-12). Foreign names fit the sounds of Arabic (ONO-02): “p” becomes ⁧ب⁩ ( ⁧بَارِيس⁩ ), ... v... ⁧ف⁩ ( ⁧فِينِيسْيَا⁩ ), "g" hard becomes ⁧غ⁩ or ⁧ج⁩ ( ⁧غُوغْل⁩ ), and (i) become i, a, u.a. When you hear a name you don't know, write it in Arabic characters as you feel it, then try to rebuild the original. Countries and nationalities. Country names often have the article ( ⁧المَغْرِب⁩ , ⁧السُّودَان⁩ ) and nationality is a nisba ( ⁧مَغْرِبِيّ⁩ , ⁧سُودَانِيّ⁩ ): ⁧المُنْتَخَبُ المَغْرِبِيُّ⁩ The Moroccan national team is the largest in the world.

6. The Egyptian: the sounds

The Egyptian in Cairo uses the same letters as the fuṣḥā, but some are pronounced differently. In Egyptian transliteration we use: g ( ⁧ج⁩ Egyptian), ʾ (hamza, even when it comes from ⁧ق⁩ ), ē and ō (long vowels born from ay and aw).

Many short vowels change or fall: kabīr → kibīr "Great', kaṯīr → kitīr Very much. by "small" is said ṣuġayyar instead of ṣaġīr. The words read, religious or technical often maintain q: ⁧القُرْآن⁩ ( il-qurʾān), ⁧اِسْتِقْلَال⁩ ( istiqlāl Independence. In writing. When the Egyptian writes (messages, subtitles, comics, social) you use the letters of fuṣḥā: ⁧ج⁩ writes ⁧ج⁩ even if you read g, and the ⁧ق⁩ stays ⁧ق⁩ even if you read ʾ. For this reason, in the Egyptian texts of this unity, transliteration is indispensable.
7. The Egyptian: the grammar to be recognized
Personal pronouns.
They ⁧هم⁩ humma ⁧هُمْ⁩
The present ⁧بـ⁩ . Adding the prefix b(i)-: is the usual or ongoing present.
they write ⁧بيكتبوا⁩ biyiktibu ⁧يَكْتُبُونَ⁩
The future with ḥa- / ha-. In place of ⁧سَـ⁩ and ⁧سَوْفَ⁩ the prefix is used ḥa- or ha-, which is written ⁧حـ⁩ or ⁧هـ⁩ .
Denial. With the verbs he wears but- before and -š after the verb (but...-š), written ⁧مَا⁩ and ⁧ـش⁩ .

⁧مِش⁩ ( miš, written ⁧مش⁩ ) denies names, adjectives, parties and the future; often corresponds to ⁧لَيْسَ⁩ . The perfect is almost the same as fuṣḥā, without endings: katab, katabt, katabti, katabna, katabtu, katabbu. Other facilities.

9. Pronunciation

Fuṣḥā The microphone. Speakers read the fuṣḥā with the terminations only in some parts; They often pause and desinence falls at the end of the sentence. Get used to recognizing words even without desinence. The fuṣḥā of the Egyptians. Many Egyptians pronounce the ⁧ج⁩ like g even when they talk fuṣḥā (e.g. in ads or on television). It is normal and correct for them; You keep saying ǧ. The Egyptian accent. The accent often falls to a different point: madrása (school) instead of mádrasa, ʾahwa instead of qáhwa. Don't imitate him: for now you just have to recognize that a word is the same, despite the different accent.

⁧٣. وُلِدَ الكَاتِبُ المِصْرِيُّ نَجِيب مَحْفُوظ عَامَ أَلْفٍ وَتِسْعِمِئَةٍ وَأَحَدَ عَشَرَ، وَحَصَلَ عَلَى جَائِزَةِ نُوبِل عَامَ⁩
⁧أَلْفٍ وَتِسْعِمِئَةٍ وَثَمَانِيَةٍ وَثَمَانِينَ.⁩
⁧٤. قَالَ المُدَرِّبُ الإِيطَالِيُّ مَارْكُو بْيَانْكِي إِنَّ فَرِيقَهُ سَيَلْعَبُ فِي بَارِيس يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ.⁩
⁧٥. سِعْرُ التَّذْكِرَةِ مِئَتَانِ وَخَمْسُونَ جُنَيْهًا.⁩
⁧٦. سَتُقَامُ المُبَارَاةُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ، السَّادِسِ وَالعِشْرِينَ مِنْ سِبْتَمْبِر، فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ مَسَاءً.⁩
⁧٧. اِرْتَفَعَ عَدَدُ الطُّلَّابِ الأَجَانِبِ بِنِسْبَةِ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ بِالمِئَةِ.⁩
⁧٨. اِسْتَقْبَلَتِ المُدِيرَةُ أَمْسِ الكَاتِبَ الفَرَنْسِيَّ بْيِير دُوبُون فِي مَكْتَبِهَا.⁩
